options.text: A speedy disposition of their cases

reveal.terms: This item is about the 1987 Constitution, Art. III, Sec. 16.
reveal.shortcut: Tie the fact to its section: Art. III, Sec. 16. Speedy disposition of cases.
reveal.why_correct: "A speedy disposition of their cases" is right. Art. III, Sec. 16 says: "the right to a speedy disposition of their cases before all judicial, quasi-judicial, or administrative bodies".

why_wrong.o1: "Free transportation to hearings" is not what this provision covers.
why_wrong.o2: "Skip preliminary investigation" is not what this provision covers.
why_wrong.o4: "Choose their own judge" is not what this provision covers.

items.stem: According to the 1987 Constitution, sovereignty resides in whom?

reveal.terms: This item is about the 1987 Constitution, Art. II, Sec. 1.
reveal.shortcut: Tie the fact to its section: Art. II, Sec. 1. All authority comes from the people.
reveal.why_correct: "The people" is right. Art. II, Sec. 1 says: "Sovereignty resides in the people and all government authority emanates from them".

why_wrong.o1: "The President" names someone who does not hold this power.
why_wrong.o3: "The Congress" names someone who does not hold this power.
why_wrong.o4: "The Armed Forces" names someone who does not hold this power.

items.stem: What is the minimum age to be appointed a member of the Supreme Court?

reveal.terms: This item is about the 1987 Constitution, Art. VIII, Sec. 7(1).
reveal.shortcut: Tie the fact to its section: Art. VIII, Sec. 7(1). A Justice must be at least 40.
reveal.why_correct: "40 years old" is right. Art. VIII, Sec. 7(1) says: "must be at least forty years of age".

why_wrong.o1: "45 years old" is a nearby number, but not the one in the text.
why_wrong.o3: "50 years old" is a nearby number, but not the one in the text.
why_wrong.o4: "35 years old" is a nearby number, but not the one in the text.

items.stem: In whom is executive power vested under the 1987 Constitution?

reveal.terms: This item is about the 1987 Constitution, Art. VII, Sec. 1.
reveal.shortcut: Tie the fact to its section: Art. VII, Sec. 1. Executive power belongs to the President.
reveal.why_correct: "The President" is right. Art. VII, Sec. 1 says: "The executive power shall be vested in the President of the Philippines".

why_wrong.o1: "The Vice-President" names someone who does not hold this power.
why_wrong.o2: "The Senate President" names someone who does not hold this power.
why_wrong.o3: "The Cabinet" names someone who does not hold this power.

items.stem: How long is the term of the Chairman of the Civil Service Commission?

reveal.terms: This item is about the 1987 Constitution, Art. IX-B, Sec. 1(2).
reveal.shortcut: Tie the fact to its section: Art. IX-B, Sec. 1(2). CSC Chairman: one 7-year term, no reappointment.
reveal.why_correct: "7 years, without reappointment" is right. Art. IX-B, Sec. 1(2) says: "for a term of seven years without reappointment".

why_wrong.o1: "6 years, with one reappointment" sounds reasonable, but the text does not say it.
why_wrong.o2: "5 years, without reappointment" is a nearby number, but not the one in the text.
why_wrong.o4: "9 years, without reappointment" is a nearby number, but not the one in the text.
